title: Best Pest Control Software for Solo Operators & Small Teams (2026)
description: GorillaDesk vs Jobber vs Housecall Pro for pest control: chemical/material tracking, device barcoding, routing and real published prices with sources.
h1: Best pest control software for solo operators and small teams
keyword: pest control software for small business
body:
Pest control adds requirements most field service tools skip: material and chemical use records, trap and device tracking, and recurring service plans. We compared three tools with public pricing. Enterprise suites without public prices are left out for now.

{{table:gorilladesk,jobber,housecall-pro}}

1. GorillaDesk: the pest-focused pick

GorillaDesk's Basic plan ($49/mo per route, month-to-month) already includes material tracking and reporting for chemical use records, automated email and SMS reminders, and Stripe/Square payments. Pro ($99/mo per route) adds device tracking and barcoding for traps and devices with trend reporting, a customer portal, e-signatures, QuickBooks Online sync and GPS tracking. Every plan includes unlimited admin and crew users, and data migration is free. SMS costs $5/mo plus message credits. {{aff:gorilladesk|See GorillaDesk plans}}

2. Jobber: general-purpose, lowest entry price

Jobber Core is $29/mo billed annually ($49/mo with no commitment) for 1 user. Its pricing page doesn't list pest-specific features like chemical logs or device barcoding (unknown). Choose it if pest is only part of your work. {{aff:jobber|See Jobber plans}}

3. Housecall Pro: recurring service plans on MAX

Basic is $59/mo billed annually. MAX adds recurring service plans (maintenance agreements) and route optimization, with 8 users included. Pest-specific chemical tracking: unknown. {{aff:housecallpro|See Housecall Pro plans}}

Bottom line

For a dedicated pest route, GorillaDesk's material tracking (on Basic) and device barcoding (on Pro) are the features we could verify. For a mixed home-services business, compare Jobber vs Housecall Pro.

faq: GorillaDesk lists material tracking and reporting for chemical use records on its Basic plan ($49/mo per route, checked 2026-10-21).
Is there pest control software with unlimited users?
GorillaDesk prices per route, and its pricing page says admin, manager, sales and crew users are unlimited and free.
Which pest control software tracks traps and devices?
GorillaDesk Pro ($99/mo per route) adds device tracking and barcoding for traps and devices, with trend reporting.
Do these pest control tools have free trials?

Jobber lists a 14-day free trial on its Grow plan and Housecall Pro a 14-day free trial on its MAX plan, both with no credit card. GorillaDesk offers a trial, but its pricing page doesn't state the length.
Which pest control software syncs with QuickBooks?
GorillaDesk syncs with QuickBooks Online on Pro and up, Jobber syncs with QuickBooks Online and Xero on Connect and up, and Housecall Pro syncs with QuickBooks Online on Essentials and up.
